q1.prompt: You must visit every node so children come after the parent for serialization. Which order?

choices.label: Preorder — visit node, then left, then right
Inorder — left, node, right (BST sorted order)

wrong_inorder.prompt: Inorder is for sorted BST walks, not prefix shape.
wrong_inorder.explanation: Preorder emits the root before children, which reconstructs tree shape. Inorder on a BST yields sorted values but loses structure without more data.

q2.prompt: Which traversal choice fails the stated goal?

choices.label: Avoid inorder on a non-binary tree with no left/right order, and do not claim level order from a plain stack DFS
Any traversal works for every ask

wrong_refuse.explanation: Avoid inorder on a general non-binary tree without defining left/right order. Avoid ignoring O(n) stack space on a skewed tree. Avoid claiming level order from a plain stack DFS — that needs a queue.

success.prompt: You matched preorder to shape and avoided mismatched traversals.
